title: “God’s correction isn’t a punishment… it’s a direction.
paragraphs:
“God’s correction isn’t a punishment… it’s a direction.
When He closes one path, He’s guiding you toward the one that carries your purpose.
If you feel Him correcting you, don’t fear it — follow it. That’s where the blessing is.”

Hebrews 12:11 (NIV)
“No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.”
